source.object: Orion Nebula: compact dark silhouette, nebulosity and nearby star
source.preprocessing: Pixel-area averaging of calibrated linear surface brightness. No background subtraction, deconvolution, noise draw or photometric renormalization. Original image axes retained.
source.missing_data_assumption: Only outside the displayed field: replace nonfinite SCI/ERR or nonpositive WHT pixels by the nearest valid SCI pixel. Original bad-pixel contribution exported separately. Zero and twice-fill sensitivity assessed for every displayed PSF. This does not reconstruct saturated flux or bound its true value.
source.quality_limit: Finite SCI/ERR and positive WHT verified in the displayed field. No independent per-exposure saturation or absolute-photometry audit. Existing JWST PSF, diffraction spikes and observational noise remain.
source.orientation: Native mosaic axes, vertically flipped for display; alignment to simulated pupil is arbitrary. No claim of a measured instrument position angle.
source.credit: NASA/ESA/CSA JWST NIRCam; GTO 1256, PI Mark J. McCaughrean; calibrated public product from MAST (STScI). Single-band display processing for this experiment.

source_extraction.operation: Exact rectangular SCI/ERR/WHT extraction; source file was range-read, not downloaded or hashed in full. Source range hashes identify retrieved bytes.

operations: Fixed observed F162M morphology with existing JWST optical response and noise; no deconvolution.
Exact rectangular overlap averages surface brightness onto the native simulation PSF grid; native sky axes retained.
All full 768x768 unit-flux PSFs retained, with original tilt; linear FFT convolution padded to at least scene+kernel-1. Crop only after convolution.
Local missing-data fill is restricted to outer context. Sensitivity uses zero and twice nominal fills, not a bound on unknown true flux.
One spatially invariant on-axis PSF over a compact field. Scene does not enter the WFS or controller. No added detector or sky noise.
One fixed asinh stretch and sequential single-band colour map for every frame and panel. No independent auto-contrast, temporal interpolation or recentering.
